selection: First populated main-driver advance entries; both original half-step solves retained

solver_contract.settings_source: Unchanged source configuration; no extra solver getter or solve was called

matrix.storage: Exact native constrained MFEM CSR, including original row/column order and stored zeros

vector_definitions.projected_previous_phi: Actual trial after original ProjectBdrCoefficient and finite-foil assignments, copied immediately before FormLinearSystem. Original projection may also touch DOFs outside the final essential mask. Never reconstructed from zeroed X.
vector_definitions.full_charge_rhs: Existing full_rhs copy of the assembled particle source before boundary elimination.
vector_definitions.constrained_rhs: Actual b after native FormLinearSystem and before the backend call.
vector_definitions.incoming_zeroed_X: Actual X after default copy_interior=0, before the backend modifies it.
vector_definitions.accepted_solution: Actual answer after existing CPU residual/finite guards passed.
vector_definitions.guard_residual: Existing CPU guard error vector A*answer-rhs; no extra matrix-vector evaluation.
